cd /workspace && timeout 170 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from compiler import compile_plan,find_deficient_cut
from compiler_proto import validate_plan
random.seed(1717)
t0=time.time();done=0
for it in range(200):
 n=random.choice([12,16,24,32,48]);np=random.choice([4,8,12,16,24,32]);np=min(np,n)
 C=sorted(random.sample(range(n),np))
 roots={v:random.choice([0,1,2,5,20]) for v in C}
 if sum(roots.values())==0:roots[C[0]]=1
 D=sum(roots.values())
 # random graph backbone+extras
 links=[];used=set()
 for v in range(1,n):
  u=random.randrange(v);used.add(tuple(sorted((u,v))))
 poss=[(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n) if (u,v) not in used]
 random.shuffle(poss)
 es=list(used)+poss[:max(0,min(128,len(poss))-len(used))]
 random.shuffle(es)
 links=[(u,v) if random.random()<.5 else (v,u) for u,v in es]
 env={i:random.choice([D*10,D*100,10**9,10**12]) for i in range(len(links))}
 p=random.choice([1,2,5])
 # likely feasible; if not, expects denied cheap
 cut=find_deficient_cut(n,links,C,roots,p,env)
 out,pay=compile_plan(n,links,C,roots,p,env)
 try:
  if cut is not None:
   assert out=='denied';continue
  assert out=='prepared'
  validate_plan(pay,n,links,C,roots,p,env);done+=1
 except Exception as e:
  print('FAIL',it,n,np,C,roots,links,env,p,cut,repr(e));raise
 if it%20==0:print(it,'done',done,'time',round(time.time()-t0,1),flush=True)
print('ALL',done,'time',time.time()-t0)
PY
